skill_name: Describe what it means to live a good life.
workflow: Living a good life means being able to live with intention and purpose. A good life includes feeling connected to both oneself and the world around them. It is important to have a sense of self-awareness and be able to identify and express one’s emotions. It is also important to engage in meaningful activities and relationships.
